summary: Eastern US Lookouts lists a Dupont Center lookout in St. Johns County; the sources read cover the place name, not the lookout itself.

evidence.supports: lookout listed as Dupont Center, St. Johns County
Dupont Center is a place near St. Augustine
place got its name when Cornelius DuPont and wife donated right of way for the highway
evidence.quote: DuPont Center got its name when Cornelius and his wife donated the right of way to the government to expand the highway.

notes_for_editor: Hold or fill before publishing. The story is below the length target because the only readable sources are the Eastern US Lookouts listing (name and county only, no build, height, staffing or status) and a DuPont House history page about the farm and the place name, not the lookout. The most relevant lead is a 2018 St. Augustine Record feature titled 'View from the top' about a longtime St. Johns County resident who spent decades atop a fire tower and whose grandfather owned Dupont Center. staugustine.com returned HTTP 403 and no archived copy was found. Also worth checking: Florida Forest Service records for a Dupont Center tower. The record's kind 'tower' is not confirmed by any source read.
